Lombard city of Monza gripped by an 'atmosphere of uninhibited racism'
subhead: 'Europe's far right takes root' (4/6). The city, one of the calmest in Italy, has been gripped by the anxieties rocking the country, fueled by Giorgia Meloni's government and its identitarian rhetoric, which has now been escalated by the National Future party, which harps on crime and ethnic themes.

title: AI and literature: 'No one in this debate has asked whether a writer has the right to work with a machine'
subhead: Writer Sébastien Bailly regrets that authors are only allowed two stances regarding artificial intelligence: that of the innocent or that of the cheat. Writers should be able to use this tool transparently, he argues for Le Monde.

title: 'Singin' in the Rain' makes a spectacular splash at Paris's Lido
subhead: Director Robert Carsen draws inspiration from the legendary 1952 film by Stanley Donen and Gene Kelly. Backed by 14 musicians and 24 performers who dance, sing and act with equal skill, the show has all the makings of a triumph.

title: Pope Leo XIV's visit shines a light on France's Catholic revival and its divisions
subhead: The pope's trip to France aims to celebrate Catholicism's renewed dynamism in the country, where baptisms among teenagers and adults have risen sharply. This phenomenon has gone hand in hand with a strengthening of conservative forces.
